_help: Every sprite sheet the game uses, by logical name. Game code loads sprites only through this file.
file is relative to the assets folder. Frames are laid out left to right in one row.
Unit sheets come in pairs: '.base' is grayscale and gets tinted to the player colour; '.detail' is drawn on top unchanged.
Replace a file with one of the same name, frame size and frame count and the game picks it up with no code changes.
The placeholder sheets are generated by: npm run gen-sprites
